title: Ask Another Team for a Change You Cannot Order
objective: Write a one-page ask for a team you do not manage, log at least three objections, and revise the ask after a concession that cuts scope, date, or offer.
whyThisMatters: Staff-plus work is mostly influence without hire-and-fire authority. A meeting that 'went well' is not evidence. The brief, the objection log, and the revised ask are.
evidence: A one-page brief that states the ask in one sentence, names a benefit for the other team, and names one thing you will do or fund
An objection log with at least three distinct objections written in the other lead's voice, each with your response
A revised ask that differs from the first in a named scope, date, or offer, after the role-play
acceptanceCriteria: The brief states the ask in a single sentence, names a benefit for Identity (not only Checkout), and names one thing Checkout will do or fund.
The objection log has at least three distinct objections; at least one concession is a scope cut, a date move, or a funded offer — not only 'we will communicate better.'
The revised ask file differs from the first ask in a named scope, date, or offer.
